notes.en: Boots the original firmware of Wenquxing NC1020, PC1000, CC800, NC2000 and NC3000 electronic dictionaries. Firmware is user-supplied: put the dumps of the chosen model under the system directory as wqxemu/<model>/ using the exact case-sensitive file names, then pick the model before starting. There is no game content; the core boots from firmware alone. Input uses the libretro keyboard interface, with the directional keys also mapped to the RetroPad.
notes.zh: 运行文曲星 NC1020、PC1000、CC800、NC2000、NC3000 电子词典的原机固件。固件需用户自备：把所选机型的转储按区分大小写的固定文件名放到系统目录 wqxemu/<model>/ 下，启动前选择机型。本机没有游戏内容，核心仅凭固件启动。输入使用 libretro 键盘接口，方向键同时映射到 RetroPad。
